newsitem.title: UK: UBS downgrades Cowie to hold from buy.
newsitem.headline: UBS downgrades Cowie to hold from buy.

text.p: Cowie Group Plc, the UK transport to leasing combine which reported a 46 percent rise in year pretax profits earlier, has been downgraded to a "hold" from a "buy" by UBS analysts.
Matthew O'Keeffe, transport analyst at UBS, told Reuters he had downgraded the shares because they were close to hitting his target price of 450 pence per share.
He said they were unlikely to gain much more on Tuesday's price which is down eight pence at 422 1/2 pence per share. UBS had classed the shares as a buy for one year.

He added that Cowie's results, although showing an impressive rise, had been in line with expectations. The pretax profits for the year ended December 31 rose 46 percent to 81.2 million stg from 55.8 million the previous year.
The dividend payout rose to 12.4 pence from 10.4 pence per share and profits rose across all four divisions.
O'Keefe said the 1997 year profit forecast was expected to be 107 million stg.
